glosses: A collection of (usually) organized information in a regular structure, usually but not necessarily in a machine-readable format accessible by a computer.

examples.text: I have a database of all my contacts in my personal organizer.

examples.text: The "books" database will have three tables, and the "customers" database will have two tables.

glosses: A software program (application) for storing, retrieving and manipulating such a structured data set.

examples.text: Which database do you use: MySQL or Oracle?

glosses: A combination of such data sets and the programs for using them.
